instruction: Please help me install the C/C++ extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the C/C++ extension (ms-vscode.cpptools) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies installation by checking if 'code --list-extensions' output contains the extension ID. Uses existing is_extension_installed metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'code --list-extensions' CLI command to extract installed VS Code extensions
Metric 'is_extension_installed' with type 'contain' correctly checks if extension ID is present in output
Expected value 'ms-vscode.cpptools' is the correct extension ID for C/C++ extension (matches source URL)
Complete coverage: instruction requires installing extension, evaluator verifies installation state
Verification is state-independent: command works regardless of UI state, no postconfig needed
Edge cases handled: returns 0.0 if extension not found, robust command-line verification approach
